steps.en: The offender is logged in and the session holds their ID
steps.id: Offender sudah login dan session menyimpan ID-nya

steps.en: The offender can open a list of paid notices
steps.id: Offender bisa membuka daftar notice yang sudah dibayar

steps.en: Only notices paid within the last months are listed
steps.id: Hanya notice yang dibayar dalam beberapa bulan terakhir tampil
steps.why_en: The period is fixed at six months in the code and counted from the suspension date, not the payment date.
steps.why_id: Periodenya tetap enam bulan di code dan dihitung dari tanggal suspension, bukan tanggal pembayaran.

steps.en: The offender can download a PDF receipt for a paid notice
steps.id: Offender bisa mengunduh receipt PDF notice yang dibayar
steps.why_en: Download works only for web payments, arrives as a zip, and is open to anyone with a notice number.
steps.why_id: Unduhan hanya berhasil untuk pembayaran lewat web, berupa file zip, dan terbuka bagi siapa pun yang punya nomor notice.

steps.en: The offender can open PDF copies of reminders sent by post
steps.id: Offender bisa membuka salinan PDF reminder yang dikirim lewat pos
steps.why_en: The portal has no page or download for reminder letters at all.
steps.why_id: Portal sama sekali tidak punya halaman atau unduhan untuk surat reminder.
